D-21 (spec.md:427-451) names only the bullet and the two platformFeatures descriptions, and AC-24 (spec.md:843-849) lists six patterns, not eight. Plan 3.6d records the FAQ deletions, so the record exists only in the plan. The en text says 'is open to', and the th package bullet (line 473) uses 'เปิดให้'. The deletion-only order caused this, and a Thai reader can still read it as a card caption. Disposition proposal: DECLINE under the deletion-only order, or ESCALATE to the owner for one added word 'เปิดให้'.
